txt: A slender white shadow, towering. Someone stands there -- raising her pistol at him. The lieutenant does not see it. He's pushing down on your wound with both hands...
It's not all dark yet. As you're leaving, she is in there too with you. You can *feel* the slender figure move, like a snake. And then a distant gunshot. Velvety smooth. Muffled.
Then -- two shots ring at once. One from the lieutenant's pistol and the other from De Paule's. It's aimed at the lieutenant, but it misses. You hear a scream behind you...
You hear a faint scream -- a woman's. Then the sound disappears, like someone pressed STOP on the tape. The woman is gone. So is Kim. Then the whole world...
"Enough already! What is this?!" The woman's voice is furious. "We didn't come here to fucking chat!"
"Fucking waste this fuck!" The woman squawks.
"I know what I heard, Korty!" The radio operator looks at him. "They said they killed him. They said it was a good way to end a Sunday night."
"I know what I heard, Korty!" The radio operator points at Titus. "They said they hanged him. All of them together. They made it *real* clear."
"It's a mind-fuck, Korty. He wasn't put it a leaf compactor. They're making it up to fuck with us." She glances at him. "Major, permission to..."
"Oh yeah, that's Ruud." The armoured woman smiles a vicious smile. "Ruud 'The Killer' Hoenkloewen -- he doesn't talk much."
"Oh, people are gonna die today. We're not leaving it like this. These *tribals* hung him up for everyone to see..."
"Ready to open fire, major. At your command."
"Ruud? Ruud is the killer --" The armoured woman smiles a vicious smile. "Ruud 'The Killer' Hoenkloewen -- he doesn't talk much."
"The kipt is merciful. Willing to spare us if we just forget about our murdered and humiliated commander." Her tone is frighteningly emotionless. "I think we should just kill everyone, Korty."
"Time? You *had* time -- to fuck around in that church!" She points over the water. "Chase some dumb drug trader. I saw you..."
"Time? You *had* time -- to fuck around in that church." She points over the water. "To run errands for your Union chief. I saw you..."
"Time? You *had* time. To fuck around on the coast." She points over the water. "Chasing some dumb drug trader. I saw you..."
"We're not fucking coming anywhere, seolite!"
"What are we waiting for?! Let's blow that pig-fucking mouth off his face!"
"What are we waiting for?" She turns to the leader. "Let's blow that big fucking mouth off his face!"
